bugs.error_message: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'datetime' where it is not associated with a value — streaming chat crashes on every message
bugs.root_cause: Line 533 had `from datetime import datetime, timezone` inside `_prepare_chat_context`. Python's scoping rules mark any name assigned anywhere in a function (including via `import`) as a local variable for the entire function. So `datetime` was a local at line 178 — before the import on 533 runs — causing UnboundLocalError. The 200 OK is already sent before the stream generator raises, so the client sees a silent stream termination.
bugs.fix: Changed `from datetime import datetime, timezone` → `from datetime import timezone` on line 533. `datetime` is already imported at module level (line 13); only `timezone` needed the local import.
